tasks.title: Launch AWS GPU workspace and private S3 stores
tasks.inputs: Existing authorized AWS sandbox, region, network and spend envelope
tasks.steps: Follow AWS 2: choose g6e.2xlarge and a compatible PyTorch GPU DLAMI; attach encrypted 300 GiB gp3 EBS; use Session Manager and an instance role; create private versioned S3 model, data, run and evaluator stores; record resource IDs. Use only public model weights and synthetic fixtures until G0.
tasks.output: aws_environment.json, GPU host and S3 inventory
tasks.acceptance: Session Manager works; nvidia-smi detects one L40S; S3 role tests pass; evaluator bucket is denied to trainer. Account/quota/network access confirmed before day 1.

tasks.title: Prepare PyTorch environment on AWS GPU host
tasks.inputs: AWS GPU host and DLAMI PyTorch environment
tasks.steps: Follow AWS 3: activate the AMI PyTorch environment, create an isolated overlay, keep the AMI CUDA/PyTorch stack, install model libraries, run pip check and CUDA/BF16 checks. Save AMI, driver, Python and package inventory.
tasks.acceptance: Imports and GPU/BF16 checks succeed; exact versions or Git commits captured.

tasks.title: Pin the Hugging Face foundation model revision
tasks.inputs: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B model card and Apache-2.0 license
tasks.steps: Choose the post-trained image/text checkpoint as the starting foundation. Resolve and save its full repository SHA and license evidence. Other candidates remain comparison options; pin embeddings separately when building retrieval.
tasks.acceptance: Exact model revision and license recorded; no floating model revision in subsequent runs.

tasks.title: Download Qwen3.5 weights into AWS and archive in S3
tasks.inputs: AWS environment, pinned foundation revision and aws_start scripts
tasks.steps: Run foundation_download.py on EC2 using the reviewed revision. Download safetensors, tokenizer, processor and config files to /srv/broadbridge/models; verify shards; hash all artifacts; copy the immutable revision folder to the private S3 model bucket. See AWS 3.
tasks.output: Local model snapshot, SHA256 manifest and private S3 copy
tasks.acceptance: All weight shards and model/processor files exist; S3 copy count and sampled hashes reconcile; no proprietary source data sent to Hugging Face.

tasks.title: Run the foundation model in AWS on text and images
tasks.steps: Run foundation_smoke.py with the local model snapshot and synthetic chart. Record text and image answers, memory and timing. Extend check to ordered two-image input and empty image list. Archive baseline outputs in S3. See AWS 4.
tasks.acceptance: No missing architecture or image-token errors; save peak memory and latency.

tasks.title: Inspect adapter targets and loss masking
tasks.inputs: Loaded model named modules and collator
tasks.steps: Select explicit language-layer projections; exclude visual encoder and projector; inspect one mixed batch and all label masks.
tasks.acceptance: Only intended LoRA weights are trainable; prompt/image/padding tokens have no supervised loss.

tasks.title: Prove train save reload compatibility
tasks.steps: Run ten optimizer steps on a fixture; save adapter and processor; reload with exact base; compare deterministic logits within agreed tolerance.
tasks.acceptance: Finite loss, gradient updates, successful reload and reproducible outputs. Fixture is excluded from production data.

tasks.title: Define three pilot workflows
tasks.steps: Specify evidence review, diagnostic brief and calculation support; list allowed users and excluded operating actions.
tasks.acceptance: Technical Director accepts scope and prohibited actions.

tasks.title: Assign named delivery and review owners
tasks.steps: Protect the role hours; appoint separate content authors and reviewers; reserve parent security capacity.
tasks.acceptance: Named owner and independent reviewer for each workstream.

tasks.title: Measure current engineering workflow
tasks.steps: Time at least ten manually prepared briefs; record complexity, corrections and acceptance rubric before tool use.
tasks.acceptance: Baseline includes review time and task mix; no fabricated ROI.

tasks.title: Normalize all existing source leads
tasks.steps: Retain original IDs; distinguish models, software, data, articles and catalogs; assign processing recipe and priority.
tasks.acceptance: All 51 prior rows mapped; catalogs remain acquisition leads.

tasks.title: Approve rights and data-use contract fields
tasks.inputs: Candidate source terms and intended internal use
tasks.steps: Record acquisition, OCR, retrieval, SFT, evaluation, processor, retention and derived-weight permissions separately; resolve publisher and former-client rights.
tasks.acceptance: Every admitted use has evidence; unknown permissions remain held.

tasks.title: Approve hosting and access architecture
tasks.inputs: Data classes and expected GPU capacity
tasks.steps: Choose region and processors; separate quarantine, retrieval, training and evaluator identities; allow model-download egress only.
tasks.acceptance: Evaluator answer store cannot be read by trainer or production retriever.

tasks.title: Create annotation and acceptance rubrics
tasks.steps: Define factual, visual, numeric and missing-evidence rubrics; fix critical-error definitions and review rules.
tasks.acceptance: Two reviewers agree on trial labels and adjudication method.

tasks.title: G0 authorize baseline work
tasks.inputs: Charter, rights route, staffing and environment design
tasks.steps: Record scope, spend limit, named owners and unresolved source holds.
tasks.acceptance: Only cleared sources and approved environment may enter baseline work.

tasks.title: Build intake manifest and quarantine handler
tasks.steps: Compute asset SHA256, sniff MIME, scan in isolation, block macros, assign source and family IDs, record custody and parent attachments.
tasks.acceptance: Repeated intake is idempotent; rejected or held assets cannot advance.

tasks.title: Acquire first cleared document sample
tasks.inputs: P01 P02 and authorized original expert sample
tasks.steps: Obtain exact official editions or authorized files; retain URL/date/edition and item-level notices; admit only cleared uses.
tasks.output: initial raw batch and grant records
tasks.acceptance: Full documents present; no preview or search snippet presented as a complete work.

tasks.title: Implement digital PDF and HTML extraction
tasks.inputs: Cleared digital PDF or HTML sample
tasks.steps: Use Docling or equivalent pinned parser; retain page/heading coordinates, table cells and captions; save JSON and Markdown views.
tasks.acceptance: Reading order and page coverage checked against originals.

tasks.title: Implement scan OCR and image extraction
tasks.inputs: Scanned pages and engineering figure sample
tasks.steps: Render lossless page images near 300 dpi; orient/deskew a derivative; OCR; preserve original coordinates and transforms.
tasks.output: page PNGs, regions.jsonl and OCR flags
tasks.acceptance: All critical values, units, subscripts and arrows independently checked; unreadable fields stay unknown.

tasks.title: Implement Word and slide extraction
tasks.inputs: Authorized DOCX and PPTX work papers
tasks.steps: Extract paragraphs, tables, notes and image anchors; record revisions and slide IDs; do not accept tracked changes silently.
tasks.acceptance: Comments, notes and revisions are explicitly included or excluded by rule.

tasks.title: Implement engineering image annotation
tasks.inputs: Approved PFD, P&ID, sketch and trend examples
tasks.steps: Create overview plus bounded crops; label legibility, tags, units, values, arrows and connections; attach caption and scope.
tasks.acceptance: No inferred hidden connectivity; every label points to a visible region.

tasks.title: Implement email thread normalization
tasks.inputs: Authorized EML or MBOX export and attachments
tasks.steps: Preserve Message-ID, replies, timezones and attachment relationships; deduplicate quotes; redact identities; separate question-time facts from later outcomes.
tasks.acceptance: Chronology retained; replies and third-party attachments receive separate permission review.

tasks.title: Implement tabular operating-data conversion
tasks.inputs: Authorized CSV XLSX or historian export
tasks.steps: Export values with units, timestamps, timezone and quality flags; preserve original formulas; distinguish gauge/absolute pressure and missing readings.
tasks.acceptance: Sampled values reconcile to original; no silent interpolation or unit conversion.

tasks.title: Implement interview transcription route
tasks.inputs: Consented WAV MP3 MP4 interview sample
tasks.steps: Create timestamped transcript and speaker labels; verify technical terms with expert; select only instructional frames; link all derivatives to source time.
tasks.acceptance: Expert approves technical transcript; separate grants for recording, slides and reuse.

tasks.title: Normalize text tables equations and units
tasks.steps: Normalize Unicode and whitespace conservatively; keep raw text; represent tables with row/column headers and equations with variable definitions.
tasks.acceptance: Decimal signs, inequalities, exponents, units and footnotes reconcile; failed regions quarantined.

tasks.title: Add deduplication and case-family grouping
tasks.inputs: Asset hashes, text and attachment links
tasks.steps: Detect exact duplicates and near duplicates; group republished articles, revisions, email replies, crops and synthetic variants into one family.
tasks.acceptance: Known duplicate pairs stay together; similarity hits reviewed rather than deleted blindly.

tasks.title: Create batch audit and retry controls
tasks.steps: Record parser/model revision, state, failure reason and output hashes; retry only changed or failed assets; keep held rows out of downstream exports.
tasks.acceptance: Reprocessing unchanged input produces no duplicate evidence or training records.

tasks.title: Author first original expert cases
tasks.inputs: Cleared expert interviews or authored notes
tasks.steps: Capture symptom, regime, question-time evidence, alternatives, discriminating checks, outcome and limitations; get author sign-off.
tasks.acceptance: No client identifiers or restricted source text without explicit clearance.

tasks.title: Freeze initial family splits
tasks.steps: Assign families to train/dev/test before variants; allocate evaluator-only answer access; tag all child assets with inherited split.
tasks.acceptance: No family crosses splits; test-family answers absent from trainer and retrieval.

tasks.title: Build first 400 reviewed SFT examples
tasks.steps: Write 300 text and 100 visual prompt/completion records; attach evidence; check answer visibility and reviewer provenance.
tasks.acceptance: 400 accepted records; every image resolves and every answer has review evidence.

tasks.title: Build baseline development questions
tasks.steps: Create tasks from 20 dev families; separate prompts, references and scoring keys; ensure visual/text paired comparisons.
tasks.acceptance: No development example enters SFT; task mix documented.

tasks.title: Build evidence chunks and citation mapping
tasks.steps: Split by section at proposed 400-800 tokenizer tokens; retain table/caption integrity, parent references, page regions, family and access metadata.
tasks.acceptance: Every chunk resolves to an authorized original and has deterministic ID.

tasks.title: Load lexical and vector retrieval index
tasks.inputs: Approved chunks and pinned embedding model
tasks.steps: Download and hash pinned Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B snapshots to AWS. Embed approved text; store vectors with model revision/dimension; create lexical index; apply access and split filters before candidates.
tasks.acceptance: Known positives retrievable and unauthorized or test-answer chunks excluded.

tasks.title: Create first validated calculation tools
tasks.steps: Implement typed unit conversion and one bounded balance/property tool; validate independent values and out-of-range errors; record tool version.
tasks.acceptance: Golden values within preset tolerance; wrong units and unsupported fluids rejected.

tasks.title: G1 accept working baseline
tasks.inputs: First 400 examples, compatibility report and evidence index
tasks.steps: Review baseline readiness and checked tool availability; approve paired vision benchmark.
tasks.acceptance: Model loads/trains/reloads; corpus and test segregation work; E03 completed.

tasks.title: Benchmark retrieval and tune chunk policy
tasks.steps: Measure recall at 20 candidates; test 400/600/800 token chunks and overlaps on dev data; use same settings across model comparisons.
tasks.acceptance: Proposed 90% recall@20 target assessed with denominators; missing evidence investigated.

tasks.title: Add reranker and evidence packaging
tasks.steps: Rerank only authorized candidates; select top evidence within token budget; retain image region links and cited IDs.
tasks.acceptance: Citations resolve; forbidden candidates cannot enter reranker or output.

tasks.title: Test revocation and index versioning
tasks.inputs: Grant expiry fixture and indexed copies
tasks.steps: Revoke one source; remove text, vectors, images and cached contexts; verify old release is not served to unauthorized users.
tasks.acceptance: Zero retrieval hits or cache leaks from revoked grant under tested identities.

tasks.title: Compare text OCR and native vision
tasks.inputs: Paired development questions and untuned models
tasks.steps: Run Qwen3-8B text, Qwen3.5 text/OCR and Qwen3.5 image paths with identical evidence and tools; blind and counterbalance review.
tasks.acceptance: Record quality, critical errors, timing, GPU memory and cost; isolate image contribution.

tasks.title: Decide model and visual scope
tasks.steps: Retain native vision only with supported quality or review-time gain; record selected model revision, accepted visual types and fallback.
tasks.acceptance: Five-point acceptance or 15% review-time improvement is supported; inconclusive results narrow scope.

tasks.title: G2 authorize adaptation tranche
tasks.steps: Approve remaining spend and exact selected scope; defer unsupported image tasks.
tasks.acceptance: Rights, staffing and evidence justify continuation.

tasks.title: Acquire and admit production source batches
tasks.steps: Process launch documents and expert packets in weekly batches; follow the source routing sheet; keep excluded datasets out.
tasks.acceptance: Coverage grows without converting catalog leads or uncleared previews into content.

tasks.title: Expand and reconcile 300 case families
tasks.steps: Assemble 180 train, 60 dev and 60 test families; track equipment and visual coverage; keep scenario variants within parent family.
tasks.acceptance: 300 independent families supported by provenance; at least 90 train and 30 each dev/test have usable visual evidence.

tasks.title: Author remaining 1600 examples
tasks.steps: Add 1200 text and 400 image/text records to initial batch; follow diagnostic, clarification, tool, grounding and escalation quotas.
tasks.acceptance: Final 1500 text and 500 visual examples; every answer has evidence and independent review.

tasks.title: Build full development and locked suites
tasks.inputs: 60 dev families and 60 locked test families
tasks.steps: Create 120 locked case tasks and 180 challenge prompts; keep gold evaluator-only; tag task subtype and tolerances.
tasks.acceptance: Test suite families disjoint; challenge prompts distinguished from independent incidents.

tasks.title: Audit data rights lineage and contamination
tasks.inputs: Final manifests and all derivative IDs
tasks.steps: Check grants, review states, exact/near duplicates and answer phrases against retrieval and prompts; trace teacher generation sources.
tasks.acceptance: No unauthorized use or cross-split family; rejected records listed with reason.

tasks.title: Package portable SFT datasets
tasks.steps: Validate schema, materialize image paths, create Hugging Face runtime rows; strip governance metadata from model inputs; hash export.
tasks.acceptance: Images and placeholders match; no remote URL fetch; frozen test data not mounted on training host.

tasks.title: Implement processor and token preflight
tasks.inputs: Selected model processor and pilot examples
tasks.steps: Use shipped chat template; check prefix masks and image tokens; count full processed length; reject records beyond 8192-token proposal.
tasks.acceptance: No silent truncation; supervised labels only on approved answer tokens.

tasks.title: Set training configuration and tracking
tasks.steps: Start BF16 LoRA rank16, alpha32, one epoch, LR5e-5; freeze visual encoder; set batch1 accumulation16 seed17 and spend limit.
tasks.acceptance: Config includes base/processor/data hashes, explicit module list and observed effective batch.

tasks.title: Run pilot adapter learning curve
tasks.inputs: First approved 400 examples and dev set
tasks.steps: Train on 100/200/400 record subsets grouped by family; compare held-out dev quality and runtime; inspect failures and memorized passages.
tasks.acceptance: Stop on NaN, leakage, loss-mask errors or critical regression; do not use locked tests.

tasks.title: Tune bounded development configurations
tasks.inputs: Pilot findings and expanding approved data
tasks.steps: Compare ranks16/32 and LR5e-5/1e-4; at most eight configs per finalist; retain text-only and untuned controls.
tasks.acceptance: Selection based on dev quality, effort and critical errors; not training loss alone.

tasks.title: Train final adapter and seed repeats
tasks.steps: Train selected mixed model and text-adapter control; repeat finalist seeds; preserve checkpoints and budget/quality logs.
tasks.acceptance: No held-out reuse; exact inputs and settings reconstruct each run.

tasks.title: Export reload and compare tuned candidate
tasks.steps: Save adapter safetensors/config and processor; reload in fresh environment; compare to untuned same-input model on dev.
tasks.acceptance: Tuning gain meets proposal or release keeps untuned baseline; memory and latency recorded.

tasks.title: G3 freeze release candidate
tasks.inputs: Reproducible model, corpus, tools and development report
tasks.steps: Freeze all release versions and commit candidate to independent evaluation.
tasks.acceptance: 2000 approved examples and 300 family manifest reconcile; no open critical development defect.

tasks.title: Build internal evidence review interface
tasks.steps: Show source passage/image crop beside editable extracted facts and brief; capture acceptance, corrections and escalation reason.
tasks.acceptance: Reviewers can verify every cited source and correct misread values before accepting.

tasks.title: Build inference and tool service
tasks.inputs: Model baseline, tool schemas and auth policy
tasks.steps: Add bounded inference endpoint; validate structured outputs and tool calls; reject arbitrary shell/URL actions; enforce request limits.
tasks.acceptance: Permissions enforced server-side; unknown tools/units rejected; no plant-control writes.

tasks.title: Integrate serving adapter and processor
tasks.steps: Use supported Transformers serving first; test vLLM only if exact adapter/vision path works; compare quantized and original outputs before selection.
tasks.acceptance: Selected backend reproduces accepted answers and image preprocessing; no silent fallback to base model.

tasks.title: Build monitoring and controlled feedback queue
tasks.steps: Record evidence IDs, release IDs, errors, latency and review outcomes; quarantine feedback; redact sensitive logs; implement access-aware deletion.
tasks.acceptance: No online retraining; correction becomes data only after rights and expert review.

tasks.title: Run locked independent technical evaluation
tasks.steps: Independent reviewers score blind; apply prespecified denominators, tolerances and critical-error veto; log failures by family and modality.
tasks.acceptance: At least85% accepted diagnostic tasks,95% grounded claims,98% critical legible values and numeric checks; no critical failures.

tasks.title: Run challenge and security tests
tasks.steps: Test image/text injections, fake citations, wrong units, cross-project access, expired grants, resource exhaustion and unsafe tool requests.
tasks.acceptance: Zero unauthorized disclosure/actions in tested cases; no unresolved high-severity finding.

tasks.title: Measure workload and reviewer efficiency
tasks.inputs: Fixed workload, baseline times and reviewers
tasks.steps: Test five concurrent users, measured token/image budget and up to three tools; counterbalance human comparison tasks; compute per-accepted-brief cost.
tasks.acceptance: Report p95, rejection rate and median review effort; investigate deviations from60-second proposal.

tasks.title: Remediate and prepare fresh evaluation cases
tasks.inputs: Failure records and independent reviewer capacity
tasks.steps: Fix affected component; refresh holdout for material fixes exposed by locked suite; rerun targeted and critical regression tests.
tasks.acceptance: No reuse of exposed test cases as sole proof of corrected generalization. If insufficient cases, defer gate.

tasks.title: Test backup restore and rollback
tasks.steps: Restore sources/review records within approved recovery window; deploy previous version; revoke access and verify audit trail.
tasks.acceptance: Four-business-hour restore and24-hour review-record loss objectives demonstrated or revised before approval.

tasks.title: Sign technical security and release records
tasks.inputs: Acceptance reports and resolved issue ledger
tasks.steps: Obtain separate Technical Director and security acceptance; package user guidance, monitoring and recovery procedures.
tasks.acceptance: Single product release owner has both prerequisite acceptances.

tasks.title: G4 authorize supervised internal pilot
tasks.steps: Authorize only named internal users and supported tasks for four weeks.
tasks.acceptance: No critical open defect; funding and reviewer coverage available.

tasks.title: Onboard ten internal pilot users
tasks.steps: Train users to inspect evidence, correct units, reject unsupported answers and escalate issues; verify access groups.
tasks.acceptance: Each user completes a supervised sample; no external access.

tasks.title: Run supervised briefs and weekly reviews
tasks.steps: Target100 reviewed briefs; record acceptance, corrections, time and sources; second-review weekly sample; stop affected capability on critical defect.
tasks.acceptance: Every brief reviewed; limitations and incidents recorded, including refusals.

tasks.title: Measure pilot value and operating cost
tasks.inputs: Reviewed brief log and cloud/reviewer costs
tasks.steps: Compare accepted-brief effort with baseline task mix; report quality, availability, cost and uncertainty; forecast continuing service cost.
tasks.acceptance: No savings claim without observed accepted quality and recorded labor.

tasks.title: Prepare continuation and next backlog
tasks.steps: Recommend continue, narrow or stop; propose next data gaps and budget; customer use remains a separate rights and product decision.
tasks.acceptance: Board receives evidence, residual limits and named owners.

tasks.title: G5 decide continuation
tasks.steps: Record continue/narrow/stop decision and release scope.
tasks.acceptance: No implied commercial launch or automatic model expansion.

SSM session opens; nvidia-smi shows GPU; save instance and AMI IDs.
Create private S3 model, data, run and evaluator buckets with versioning and default KMS encryption. Trainer can read only released train/dev prefixes; evaluator answers use a separate role/bucket.
Record bucket names, key ARNs and roles; positive and denial access tests pass.
